verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of an authenticator or credential app, since comparable products in this category ship command-line tools, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only mobile-app workflows: QR scanning, push approvals, App Lock, backup and export. Nothing documents an official command-line interface, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
